sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the court p  following:
 ORDER

After arguing for sometime, when this Court was not inclined to grant bail, learned counsel for the applicant seeks leave of this Court to withdraw this first bail application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail on behalf of the applicant in connection with Crime No.72/2023, registered at Police Station-Chhatripura, District-Indore (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 406,
420 of IPC.
The application is accordingly dismissed as withdrawn.
